references.name: street-2015.jpg
references.observed: 2015 whole long street facade actually inspected: broad dark glazed curtain-wall band with two main rows of framing, pale limestone/stone upper wall with small narrow vents, a closed flat roof and an attached low glazed/stone entrance canopy extending to the northeast. Cars,buses,tram wires,road and corporate/shop lettering are contextual. No copied brands or signs.

references.name: main-building-2024.jpg
references.observed: 2024 whole main passenger-building street/clock-end view actually inspected: same pale flat-roof building with long dark curtain wall, white flat entrance canopy and closed doors, a round unbranded clock on the northeast end with tall narrow vertical windows, roof vents/stacks and service boxes. A taller brown Go Hotel block to the southwest, a detached curved underpass shelter and other modern pavilions are separate context. Hidden platform/rear inventory is not shown; use original medium-fi returns.

note: Two ordinary front/clock-end pictures plus current standard PMTiles and standard viewer terrain. Reference station point is separate from the physical main building anchor. Source pictures remain local observations,not redistributed textures. No bespoke research.
